each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

Output a 3x3 grid: use the dominant/background color as the default; put 1 in each output position whose panel contains exactly two minority cells (demos: panels with one minority cell retain background; panels with two become 1). Example test: input 11x11 split by 3-lines into nine 3x3 panels, base 0, minority 5; panels middle-right and bottom-right had two 5s, yielding [[0,0,0],[0,0,1],[0,0,1]]. Demo variants included 2x2 panels with base 3/minority 5 and 2x5 panels with base 5/minority 9. )
